test_name_change_case: test the polars name.to_uppercase and name.to_lowercase methods to rename DataFrame columns
test_name_prefix_suffix: test the polars name.prefix and name.suffix methods to prepend or append strings to column names
test_name_replace: test the polars name.replace method to rename columns using regex patterns or literal strings
test_name_keep: test the polars name.keep method to preserve original column names after transformations
test_name_map_chain: test chaining polars name.to_lowercase and name.suffix methods together on column names
